summary: OpenAI announced a strategic collaboration with the bank BBVA, describing enterprise-wide ChatGPT adoption and custom GPT use across customer service, risk, legal and operations.

categories.reason: The bank is embedding AI directly into credit risk assessment and other core banking decision workflows, not just general productivity.
categories.quote: In credit risk, BBVA developed Credit Analysis Pro GPT, which accelerates assessments by extracting and analyzing unstructured data from annual reports, ESG disclosures, and media coverage
